_readme: Settings for the homepage contour background. Edit, then run: cd tools/terrain && npm install && node build.mjs
_source_options: procedural = temporary stand-in terrain | dem = real elevation file (set demFile)
_demFile_note: GeoTIFF (.tif) or ASCII grid (.asc) from OpenTopography. Put it in tools/terrain/data/

placement._note: Where the terrain sits in the frame. 0-1 of the frame. Lines live upper-right; centre and lower-left stay open.
placement._scale_note: 1 = as wide as the elevation file allows; smaller zooms in.

contours._count_note: Roughly how many contour levels from the lowest visible line to the summit. More = denser.
contours._cutoff_note: 0-1. Elevations below this fraction are not drawn, which keeps the lower-left empty.

dem._summitLabel_note: {ft} is filled in from the highest point in the elevation file, so the number is always the data's own.
dem._summitLonLat_note: Mount Bierstadt summit [lon, lat]. The build finds the true high point within ~300 m of this.
